result.title: DisaggKD: Efficient Knowledge Distillation through Teacher-Student Disaggregation and a Fused Loss
result.summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) frameworks place teacher and student on the same GPUs, so per-GPU memory limits the teachers that fit. DisaggKD separates them across nodes: teacher replicas stream hidden states to the student, a KD loss over row windows and vocabulary shards equals the full-vocabulary loss in exact arithmetic without forming the full-vocabulary logits, and a prefetch ring paces producer and trainer. Closed-form memory and traffic models locate the memory limits of each layout. On the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to 9B pair, the disaggregated layout matches the LM loss of the colocated run with the same loss and is faster than that run; our fused loss also lets a colocated run train on as few nodes at faster speed, while the split is memory efficient when the student spans several nodes. On the larger pairs, colocated runs with a fused loss still run OOM where the split trains, because teacher weights and student states fill the budget.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 DisaggKD：把知识蒸馏的教师与学生拆分到不同节点，教师副本跨节点流式传输隐藏状态，并用行窗口与词表分片上的融合损失替代全词表 logits，同时给出显存与通信量的闭式模型。
